modules.module_title: Inspect and prepare the slurry pump unit for operation

pcs.pc_description: check various controls, gauges, slurry pump and allied components and accessories for proper functioning and any defect
check the direction of rotation of motor is corresponding to the regulated rotation direction of pump and ensure that motor should be tested alone and it must not be connected with pump during check
ensure that concentricity of motor shaft and slurry pump shaft is correct and elastic cushion of coupling is correct and complete
check the impeller clearance by manually turn the slurry pump (including motor) for detecting any friction, tightness etc. in it
check the bearing oil level in the bearing box and replenish it as per SOP, if requires
check the condition of inlet and outlet valves and ensure that they are working properly and in normal state
check the pipe system and other parts such as anchor bolt, flange sealing gasket and other bolts for proper working and good condition
check all foundation bolts and outlet pipework bolts for appropriate tightness and condition
ensure all electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, sealant and lubrication systems (as applicable) are connected and operational
add the seal water (cooling water for mechanical seal), before starting the slurry pump
perform pump priming by opening the air vents on the inlet and outlet piping until the pumped fluid flows out and after that closing the air vents
ensure the inlet pipe and pump casing are completely full of liquid before starting continuous duty operation and pump fluid must be above the pump casing
maintain the operation and maintenance logbook to detail all activities conducted before starting the operation
report defects precisely to the supervisor if beyond scope of his/her role

modules.module_title: Start and operate the slurry pump unit

pcs.pc_description: ensure flushing and/or cooling liquid supplies are turned on and all vent connections are closed before starting the pump
open the inlet valve and fully close or partially open the outlet valve before starting the pump
open any recirculation or cooling lines
start the motor and slowly open the outlet valve until the pump reaches the desired flow
check the pressure gauge to ensure that the pump reaches the required outlet pressure
stop the pump, if there is no pressure or low pressure
perform the pump priming process again and restart the motor again
monitor the pump for bearing temperature, excessive vibration, and noise during the operation
shut down the pump immediately, if the pump exceeds normal levels and take the corrective action as per SOP
repeat steps 6,7,8 and 9 until the pump runs properly
check the oil level at regular intervals
observe any slurry leakage during the pump operation and stop the pump immediately, if found
close the outlet valve, but ensure that the pump runs in this condition for no more than a few seconds
stop the pump
switch off flushing and/or cooling/heating liquid supplies at a time appropriate to the process
maintain and complete all required documentation clearly, concisely as per SOP

modules.module_title: Repair and maintain the slurry pump

pcs.pc_description: perform basic health check-up of slurry pump unit as specified in the maintenance checklist
check the level and condition of the oil through the sight glass on the bearing frame
replenish coolants and lubricants as per SOP
clean dirt and dust from areas around close clearances, bearing housings and motors
check coupling alignment and re-align if necessary

check the slurry pump parts i.e. motor, impellers, casing, shaft and bearing assembly, shaft sleeves, seals, strainer, agitator, auxiliary supplies e.g. heating/cooling (if fitted) wiring harness, connectors etc. for proper functioning to find out root cause of the problems like any leakage, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, etc. and discuss the same with senior if required
check for unusual noise vibration and bearing temperatures
check the pump and piping, seal chamber and stuffing box etc. for leaks
check any are functioning correctly
check the instrument panel and control gauge to identify out of range readings to find the defect/cause of failure
replace/change the spare parts and consumables of the slurry pump as per the schedule
ensure proper lock out and tag out of slurry pump to avoid any untoward incident triggered due to unknowingly operation of machine / system under maintenance
assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
conduct trial run of the slurry pump unit rig and verify that specified parameters are attained with no abnormalities
dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
fill the daily, weekly and monthly maintenance/defect sheets as per the format lay down by the organization
record all repairs carried out, time taken and unplanned tasks encountered during the maintenance activities
